title: post api auth register user registration
description: Test user registration with valid payload including name, email, password, and role. Expect 201 response with created user id and status 'pending'.

title: post api auth login user login
description: Test user login with valid credentials. Expect 200 response with JWT token.

title: get api auth status email check user status
description: Test retrieving user account status by email without authentication. Expect 200 response with account status such as 'pending' or 'active'.

title: get api employees get all employees with access control
description: Test retrieving all employees with valid authentication and role-based access control. Expect 200 response with employee list for authorized users.

title: get api employees pending get pending users admin hr only
description: Test retrieving pending employees list with valid admin or HR authentication. Expect 200 response with list of pending employees. Test access with regular user and expect 403 forbidden.

title: put api employees id approve approve pending user
description: Test approving a pending user by employee id with valid admin or HR authentication. Expect 200 response with updated employee status 'active'. Test approving non-existent user and expect 404 not found.

title: get api tasks get all tasks authorized
description: Test retrieving all tasks with valid authentication. Expect 200 response with list of tasks. Test without authentication and expect 401 unauthorized.

title: get api tasks my tasks get logged in user tasks
description: Test retrieving tasks assigned to the logged-in user with valid authentication. Expect 200 response with list of user's tasks.

title: post api tasks create assign new task
description: Test creating and assigning a new task with valid payload including title, description, and assigneeId with valid authentication. Expect 201 response with created task id. Test with invalid assigneeId and expect 400 or 404 validation error.
